name: BRLP
description: $BRLP is the official PagFinance stablecoin, fully backed 1:1 by the Brazilian Real (BRL). Available across multiple blockchains, it employs on-chain mint and burn mechanisms for auditable transparency, with each $BRLP representing one fiat real held in custody. Beyond powering payments, settlements, and transfers across the PagFinance ecosystem, $BRLP serves as a building block for DeFi: liquidity pools, swaps, collateral, and yield strategies, as well as treasury management and cross-border flows. $BRLP stands as a transparent and permanent digital asset, bridging traditional finance and Web3 innovation from Brazil to the world.
short_description: $BRLP is PagFinance's stablecoin, fully backed 1:1 by the Brazilian Real. A multichain asset for payments, settlements, and DeFi, with auditable on-chain mint and burn.
